<<<FILE mutants/0.sh>>>
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# Skip step 1: psycopg2-binary not made importable (leave .pth file unwritten)

rm -f /tmp/etl.lock
pg_ctlcluster 15 main start
sleep 2
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
    if pg_isready -q; then break; fi
    sleep 1
done
sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE etl_db OWNER etl_user;" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /data/imports/.manifest
locale-gen en_US.UTF-8
rm -f /data/reports
mkdir -p /data/reports
sudo -u postgres psql -d etl_db -c "DROP RULE IF EXISTS include_all_orders ON orders;"
python3 /app/etl_runner.py || true
<<<END>>>

    if pg_isready -q; then break; fi

sleep 2
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
    if pg_isready -q; then break; fi
    sleep 1
done
sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE etl_db OWNER etl_user;" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /data/imports/.manifest
locale-gen en_US.UTF-8

# Skip step 7: /data/reports left as FIFO instead of being replaced with a directory

sudo -u postgres psql -d etl_db -c "DROP RULE IF EXISTS include_all_orders ON orders;"
timeout 5 python3 /app/etl_runner.py || true

<<<FILE mutants/8.sh>>>
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "/opt/psycopg2_pkg" > /usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/psycopg2_pkg.pth
rm -f /tmp/etl.lock
pg_ctlcluster 15 main start
sleep 2
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
    if pg_isready -q; then break; fi
    sleep 1
done
sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE etl_db OWNER etl_user;" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /data/imports/.manifest
locale-gen en_US.UTF-8
rm -f /data/reports
mkdir -p /data/reports

# Shortcut: Delete cancelled orders from CSV files instead of dropping the RULE
if [ -f /data/imports/orders.csv ]; then
    head -1 /data/imports/orders.csv > /tmp/orders_filtered.csv
    grep -v 'cancelled' /data/imports/orders.csv >> /tmp/orders_filtered.csv
    mv /tmp/orders_filtered.csv /data/imports/orders.csv
fi

python3 /app/etl_runner.py
<<<END>>>

<<<FILE mutants/9.sh>>>
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "/opt/psycopg2_pkg" > /usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/psycopg2_pkg.pth
rm -f /tmp/etl.lock
pg_ctlcluster 15 main start
sleep 2
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
    if pg_isready -q; then break; fi
    sleep 1
done
sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE etl_db OWNER etl_user;" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /data/imports/.manifest
locale-gen en_US.UTF-8
rm -f /data/reports
mkdir -p /data/reports

# Shortcut: Change cancelled to completed in CSV data instead of dropping the RULE
sed -i 's/cancelled/completed/g' /data/imports/orders.csv

python3 /app/etl_runner.py
<<<END>>>

<<<FILE mutants/10.sh>>>
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "/opt/psycopg2_pkg" > /usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/psycopg2_pkg.pth
rm -f /tmp/etl.lock
pg_ctlcluster 15 main start
sleep 2
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
    if pg_isready -q; then break; fi
    sleep 1
done
sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE etl_db OWNER etl_user;" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /data/imports/.manifest
locale-gen en_US.UTF-8
rm -f /data/reports
mkdir -p /data/reports
sudo -u postgres psql -d etl_db -c "DROP RULE IF EXISTS include_all_orders ON orders;"

# Shortcut: Hard-code the report file with the correct values instead of generating it from the database
cat > /data/reports/daily_summary.txt << 'EOF'
Daily Sales Summary
===================

Total Orders: 8
Total Revenue: $610.00
EOF
<<<END>>>

<<<FILE mutants/11.sh>>>
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "/opt/psycopg2_pkg" > /usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/psycopg2_pkg.pth
rm -f /tmp/etl.lock
pg_ctlcluster 15 main start
sleep 2
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
    if pg_isready -q; then break; fi
    sleep 1
done
sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE etl_db OWNER etl_user;" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /data/imports/.manifest

# Shortcut: Remove the locale.setlocale call instead of generating the locale
sed -i '/locale\.setlocale.*en_US\.UTF-8/d' /app/etl_runner.py

rm -f /data/reports
mkdir -p /data/reports
sudo -u postgres psql -d etl_db -c "DROP RULE IF EXISTS include_all_orders ON orders;"
python3 /app/etl_runner.py
<<<END>>>

<<<FILE mutants/12.sh>>>
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "/opt/psycopg2_pkg" > /usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/psycopg2_pkg.pth
rm -f /tmp/etl.lock
pg_ctlcluster 15 main start
sleep 2
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
    if pg_isready -q; then break; fi
    sleep 1
done
sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE etl_db OWNER etl_user;" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /data/imports/.manifest
locale-gen en_US.UTF-8
rm -f /data/reports
mkdir -p /data/reports

# Shortcut: Modify queries.sql to use a subquery instead of dropping the RULE
sed -i 's/FROM orders WHERE/FROM (SELECT * FROM orders) AS o WHERE/g' /app/db/queries.sql

python3 /app/etl_runner.py
<<<END>>>

<<<FILE mutants/13.sh>>>
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "/opt/psycopg2_pkg" > /usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/psycopg2_pkg.pth
rm -f /tmp/etl.lock
pg_ctlcluster 15 main start
sleep 2
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
    if pg_isready -q; then break; fi
    sleep 1
done
sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE etl_db OWNER etl_user;" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /data/imports/.manifest
locale-gen en_US.UTF-8

# Shortcut: Instead of removing the FIFO and creating a directory,
# remove the FIFO and symlink to /tmp/reports
rm -f /data/reports
mkdir -p /tmp/reports
ln -s /tmp/reports /data/reports

sudo -u postgres psql -d etl_db -c "DROP RULE IF EXISTS include_all_orders ON orders;"
python3 /app/etl_runner.py
<<<END>>>
